aliases: Furnace camera kit with temperature measurement
sensor: Thermal (12 um pixel pitch, 8 to 14 um spectral range, NETD < 35 mK)
operating_temp_c: furnace application up to 2000 C (cooling protection required)
features: industrial furnace / kiln thermal camera kit with temperature measurement
dual measurement ranges 0-800 C / 300-2000 C with point/line/frame analysis
built-in flameout detection and active-burner counting algorithm (>99% accuracy)
dual-layer forced vortex air cooling for furnaces up to 2000 C
thermal detector: 12 um pixel pitch, NETD < 35 mK, 8-14 um
gigabit Ethernet, microSD storage up to 512 GB
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2XT6028G0-L is an industrial furnace/kiln thermal camera kit with in-furnace temperature measurement (0-800 C / 300-2000 C), flameout detection and a forced vortex air-cooling system for operation in furnaces up to 2000 C. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet DS-2XT6028G0-L_C200K_Datasheet_20260414.pdf.
